thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] node/gpu-node-12 DiskPressure -> multiple modelcache pods restarting (OOM/CUDA errors). Auto-pager fired: SRE oncall. https://internal.monitoring/alerts/2309876543 :rotating_light:

Maria S. (oncall): ack, I'm on it. looking at logs now.

Sam W.: quick check - `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep modelcache` shows 3/6 pods CrashLoopBackOff on gpu-node-12, others distributed on gpu-node-14/15.

Maria S. (oncall): seeing repeated exit code 137 in pod logs + `cudaInit: out of memory` on the runtime side. also kernel message: "Write cache pressure -> evicting pods".

Raj P.: is this whole node saturated with logs or model artifacts? can you paste `du -sh /var/lib/modelcache/*` and `df -h`?

Maria S. (oncall): pastebin: https://internal.gists/abc123 - /var/lib/modelcache shows ~420GB used, node has only 480GB ephemeral. /var/log/syslog shows aggressive writeback from modelcache and runc overlay.

Ethan L.: that explains eviction cascade. modelcache is writing checkpoints and debug logs. If ephemeral fills -> kubelet marks DiskPressure -> evict pods -> modelcache restarts and re-populates cache -> repeat.

Maria S. (oncall): customer impact: Support flagged increased 502s for a high-traffic tenant (TID-778). Elevated error rate started ~2309876480. I'm collecting traces.

Support Bot: ticket TID-778 created: https://internal.zendesk/tickets/778 - marked SEV2. Notifying Account Lead. :white_check_mark:

Sam W.: mitigation plan: 1) cordon gpu-node-12 2) drain to stop new pods landing 3) delete orphaned large logs on the node to free space 4) restart runtime on drained pods/nodes 5) temporarily reduce modelcache size limit or change eviction policy.

Maria S. (oncall): executing commands now:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

Maria S. (oncall): running remote cleanup on gpu-node-12: `du -sh /var/log/redwood/* | sort -h` -> a few rotated logs are 150GB combined. deleting old rotated logs older than 7 days.

Raj P.: can we avoid full delete by moving large model shards off to /mnt/nvme-temp? node has an unmounted nvme with 1.2TB free.

Maria S. (oncall): copying biggest shards to /mnt/nvme-temp now: `rsync --remove-source-files -a /var/lib/modelcache/shard-* /mnt/nvme-temp/` - started. ETA ~2m.

Ethan L.: also reduce runtime cache size env var so new pods don't warm the cache to full size: set MODEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=200000000000 (200GB) in the deployment temporarily and rollout.

Sam W.: I'm patching the deployment: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/modelcache MODEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=200000000000` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/modelcache` to ensure restart with new limit.

Maria S. (oncall): modelcache pods coming up clean on gpu-node-14/15, OOMs stopped on those nodes. gpu-node-12 freed ~260GB after log and shard move.

incident-bot: node/gpu-node-12 leave DiskPressure state detected; kubelet stopped evicting.

Maria S. (oncall): rescheduled 4 pods back onto gpu-node-12 after cleanup. monitoring memory and disk metrics closely.

Ethan L.: for immediate protection, I recommended enabling `kubelet.evictionHard` thresholds increase for ephemeral-storage from 90% -> 95% while we stabilize, and also enabling logrotate on modelcache to keep rotated logs <2GB each.

Raj P.: long-term fix items (we should track these): 1) provision dedicated hostPath or PVC for modelcache 2) add guardrail in deployment to fail fast if model shards > X 3) change runtime to use LRU prioritized eviction and async checkpointing 4) enforce debug logs off in prod.

Maria S. (oncall): customer impact summary for handoff: TID-778 saw 10-15% request errors (~502/503) for ~8m window (2309876480-2309876760). Latency spikes for several other tenants but no data loss.

Ops Pager: thanks, Maria. I'll take next 2hr watch to ensure no regression. leaving a playbook note in runbook: https://internal.docs/runbooks/modelcache-ephemeral-pressure.

Maria S. (oncall): handing off to Ops Pager. actions taken: cordoned/drained node, cleaned 260GB of logs/shards, limited model cache to 200GB, rolled out restarted deployment, adjusted temporary kubelet eviction threshold. Follow-ups created: RDW-INC-2309 (storage+PVC for modelcache), RDW-CHG-2310 (runtime LRU patch), RDW-OPS-2311 (logrotate enforcement).

Support Bot: updated ticket TID-778 with mitigation notes and customer-facing timeline.

Ops Pager: ack, will monitor and escalate to infra if disk usage climbs. Maria, thanks for fast response. :pray:

Maria S. (oncall): thanks team. I'm going offline in 10m, reached out to infra to schedule PVC migration.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by Ops Pager at 2309876620.
